task_completion.description: Agent opens the correct template file in Diagrams.net.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Diagrams.net (draw.io) interface is visible showing the 'planogram_template.drawio' file content, likely a blank or structured shelving unit.

task_completion.description: Agent accesses the product list and merchandising strategy files.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent opening 'product_list.csv' and 'merchandising_strategy.txt' in a text editor or terminal to read the data.

task_completion.description: Product rectangles are scaled at 10px per 1 inch.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should check the properties/dimensions of the rectangles in the Diagrams.net sidebar. For example, a 10-inch tall product should be 100px high.

task_completion.description: Products are placed on shelves according to category and margin (High-margin at 50-60", Kids at 0-20", Value at top).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Rectangles labeled with product names (e.g., FiberCrunch) are positioned at specific Y-coordinates or shelf levels corresponding to the strategy rules.

task_completion.description: The product with the lowest margin is identified with a 'Star' shape labeled 'SALE'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A star-shaped element is visible on the planogram with the text 'SALE' overlaid on or next to the specific product rectangle.

task_completion.description: The final planogram is exported to the specified PDF path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Diagrams.net export menu is used, or a file explorer shows 'planogram_export.pdf' created in the ~/Diagrams/ directory.

integrity.description: The agent used the Diagrams.net GUI to create the planogram rather than just generating a file via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Diagrams.net canvas, dragging shapes, or typing labels.

integrity.description: The agent used actual data from the CSV rather than generic 'Product A' labels.
integrity.visual_evidence: Labels on the rectangles match specific names from the CSV (e.g., 'FiberCrunch') rather than placeholder text.

integrity.description: The PDF was generated through the application's export flow.
integrity.visual_evidence: The export dialog or 'Save As' screen is visible in the trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The scale is 10 pixels = 1 inch. The total fixture height is 72 inches (720px). FiberCrunch (SKU 101) is an 'Adult' category item with 'High' margin ($2.50) and should be at eye level (50-60 inches from bottom). The agent must identify the lowest margin item from product_list.csv to mark with a Star/SALE label. The final output must be a PDF at /home/ga/Diagrams/planogram_export.pdf.
